approvalBasis: Daniel's blanket authorization for graphic publication (handoff 2026-09-23); not a per-graphic inspection by Daniel.
notes: Packet 1. Per this packet's notes, Hashkiveinu (Daniel)/(Jim)/(plain) are three ALTERNATE settings, not sequential parts of one piece (WORKER-PROTOCOL.md 'Catalog packets' section) -- judged each on its own rather than forcing a left-panel conversion under the >2-parts rule. All three are already bottom lower thirds, arrangement blocks, and each reads as a single readable lower third at current size; left as bottom, no style change made. Other Hashkiveinu drafts in the library (Take This Soul/U2, HHD 1, HHD 2, Randy) are not in this packet and were not touched. Typo fix 2026-09-23: accent doubled patach corrected on all three and republished (revision 3 each); fit unchanged.

typoFix.basis: Main-thread decision 2026-09-23 (typo fix, Miryam accent precedent)
typoFix.note: Removed exactly one U+05B7 from the doubled patach; the rest of the string is unchanged, including the existing order hiriq-then-dagesh on kaf (U+05DB U+05B4 U+05BC, NFC). The packet's codepoint list gives dagesh-then-hiriq (U+05DB U+05BC U+05B4), which is canonically equivalent (NFC-equal) but not byte-identical; the existing order was kept per 'change nothing else'.
